query_purpose: Identify LLM-, generative-AI-, or AI-assisted approaches to software effort or Story Point estimation and evidence about how AI changes estimation practice.
interpretation_boundary: Query engineering from title and abstract only; not eligibility screening, study inclusion, evidence synthesis, or PRISMA input.

selection.method: Preserve export order after exact source-ID deduplication; select first 10 and last 10 records.
selection.scope_note: This bounded 20-record appraisal meets the executable registry minimum requested for OA-S3R. It does not satisfy the appendix's larger >=50 sample required to freeze a 51-1000-record query.
